N.B.: The brake node sends the ABS warning light on message via the C-CAN to the Body Computer which makes it available via the gateway to the Instrument Panel Node through the B-CAN.

In the event of faults in the C-CAN network, the fault warning lights for the control units that communicate via this network will light up. The CAN NETWORK INFORMATION check is intended to test for this problem.
